description: Receipt replay identity currently fingerprints the full non-transport receipt structure. A second receipt with the same targetRef, clauseRef, canonical GUT identity, canonical provenance and triage classification but a changed summary or other decorative field can therefore qualify as a second receipt and inflate qualifyingReceiptCount/aliasAudit without adding a new metabolic diagnosis.
requiredFix: Deduplicate qualifying GUT triage receipts by bounded diagnostic identity while retaining structural receipt fingerprints for audit. Same provenance with a genuinely different classification must remain a conflict rather than being suppressed.
promotion: Blocked until focused adversarial tests and cross-organ/integration regression pass in GitHub Actions.
privacy: Synthetic/de-identified evidence only; no private connector identifiers or source text.
